param.name: source
param.label: Species tree source
param.help: Choose an existing species tree or generate an initial tree.

param.name: species_tree
param.label: Species tree
param.help: One rooted, bifurcating species tree in Newick format. Species names must match those in the mapping files.

param.name: species_tree_search
param.label: Optimization of species tree
param.help: Choose how AleRax optimizes your starting species tree.
param.option: SKIP: skip the species tree search (default)
HYBRID: standard search (transfer-guided and local SPR moves)

param.name: gene_trees
param.label: Gene tree samples (one file per gene family)
param.help: A list collection: each element is one gene family.

param.name: mappings
param.label: Gene to species mapping files (optional)
param.help: Optional. One gene to species mapping file per gene family.

param.name: rec_model
param.label: Reconciliation model
param.help: --rec-model. UndatedDTL models duplications, transfers and losses. UndatedDL models only duplications and losses (no transfers).

param.name: model_parametrization
param.label: Model parametrization
param.help: --model-parametrization. Defines which model parameters are shared among species or families.

param.name: gene_tree_samples
param.label: Number of output reconciled gene tree samples per family.
param.help: --gene-tree-samples. Default is 100. More samples give more stable averages but take longer.

param.name: seed
param.label: Random seed
param.help: --seed. Default is 123. Use the same seed to get exactly the same results again.

param.name: archive
param.label: Also output the complete results folder as one archive (.tar)
param.help: Contains all AleRax result files, including every sampled reconciliation.

tool.help:
**What it does**
AleRax performs species tree - gene tree inference and reconciliation under gene duplication, loss, and horizontal gene transfer (HGT).
For each gene family, it takes as input a gene tree distribution (typically inferred with Bayesian inference tools such as MrBayes or PhyloBayes).
**Two ways to use it**
- *You already have a species tree*: choose "From history", select your tree, and keep the search on SKIP. AleRax reconstructs the history of each gene family on your tree. - *You do not have a species tree*: choose "Infer with MiniNJ". AleRax then automatically searches for the best species tree (HYBRID), and reconstructs the history of each gene family on it.
**Inputs**
- A starting species tree: your own rooted tree (Newick), a MiniNJ estimate, or a random tree. - A list collection of gene tree samples, one element per gene family. - Optionally, a list collection of gene-to-species mapping files.
Each mapping file must have exactly the same collection element identifier as its corresponding gene tree. For example, a gene tree element named `family_381` must have a mapping element named `family_381`. The dataset filenames themselves do not need to be identical.
Each line of a mapping file contains a gene name and a species name, for example:
``` ENSPTRP00000091955 PanUUUTroglodytes ENSCSAP00000007477 ChlorocebusUUUSabaeus ```
Gene and species names can be separated by a space or a tab. Species names must be written exactly as in the species tree.
If you do not provide mapping files, AleRax reads the species name from each gene tree leaf label: everything before the first underscore. For example, the leaf `HomoUUUSapiens_ENSP00000363832` belongs to the species `HomoUUUSapiens`.
**Species tree search** (only asked when you use your own species tree; MiniNJ and random trees always use HYBRID)
- SKIP: skip the species tree search (default) - REROOT: only re-estimate the root of the starting species tree - HYBRID: standard search (a mix of transfer-guided and local SPR moves)
**Reconciliation model**
- UndatedDTL (default): gene duplication, transfer and loss. - UndatedDL: gene duplication and loss only (no transfers). - Model parametrization: GLOBAL (default) estimates one set of rates for all families and species, PER-FAMILY one set per gene family, PER-SPECIES one set per species. According to the AleRax documentation, PER-SPECIES is not compatible with species tree inference, so use it only with SKIP.
**Advanced options**
- Number of samples: how many reconciled gene trees AleRax samples per family (default 100). - Random seed: use the same seed to reproduce a run exactly (default 123). - Archive: also return the complete AleRax results folder as one .tar file.
**Outputs**
- The species tree (your tree, or the one AleRax built). - The AleRax log (settings used, progress and likelihood scores). - The per-family likelihoods (tabular). - A collection with the per-family event counts (tabular: duplications, transfers, losses per species). - A collection with the per-family transfers (tabular: which species passed genes to which). - Optionally, an archive with all result files.
**More information**
See the AleRax wiki: [Running AleRax](https://github.com/BenoitMorel/AleRax/wiki/Running-AleRax), [Gene-to-species mapping](https://github.com/BenoitMorel/AleRax/wiki/Gene-to-species-mapping) and [Outputs](https://github.com/BenoitMorel/AleRax/wiki/Outputs).
